Action Input: {"path": "/results/claude_35/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/alpha_quartz_surface_1_slab_energy_minimisation_trial_3/in.slab_relax", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for SiO2 slab relaxation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p f

# Create simulation box and atoms
read_data /results/claude_35/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/alpha_quartz_surface_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_3/alpha_quartz.data

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes

# Define potential
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /results/claude_35/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/alpha_quartz_surface_1_subtask_potential_file_trial_3/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Set masses explicitly
mass 1 28.0855  # Si
mass 2 15.9994  # O

# Create initial velocity
velocity all create 300.0 4928459 rot yes dist gaussian

# Replicate the system
replicate 5 5 5

# Energy minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Save relaxed structure
write_data /results/claude_35/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/alpha_quartz_surface_1_slab_energy_minimisation_trial_3/relaxed_slab.data

# Get and save final energy
variable E equal pe
print "${E}" file /results/claude_35/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/alpha_quartz_surface_1_slab_energy_minimisation_trial_3/energy.txt
"}
